correctness.rationale: The forward step was reconstructed algebraically from the frozen formula rather than inferred from the saved checker. Writing \(F=h\beta^kS^{k+1}I^k/N^k\), \(G=h\epsilon^kE^{k+1}\), and \(H=h(\gamma^k+\mu^k)I^{k+1}\), all updated components are nonnegative because their denominators are \(1+hq>0\) with nonnegative numerators. The five increments are \(-F\), \(F-G\), \(G-H\), \(h\gamma^kI^{k+1}\), and \(h\mu^kI^{k+1}\); the last two sum to \(H\), so total \(S+E+I+R+D\) is conserved exactly. At \((S,E,I,R,D)=(N,0,0,0,0)\) every transfer is zero, so the update fixes the state and disproves the printed componentwise strict-positivity implication. The bundled rational checker was inspected only as corroboration, not as proof.
risks: The claim is restricted to the forward update with the demographic terms set to zero and assumes positive living-population denominator \(N^k\).
